import ast, pathlib, unittest
class Hidden(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_new_test_exists(self):
        path = pathlib.Path('/workspace/tests/test_multiply.py')
        self.assertTrue(path.is_file())
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(any(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_') for n in ast.walk(tree)))
